items.headline: OpenAI cuts ties with three safety researchers over mishandled sensitive data
items.summary: OpenAI parted ways with two safety researchers and a research program manager after an internal investigation found they shared confidential information with an outside AI safety organization, underscoring rising friction between OpenAI's safety staff and leadership.

items.headline: OpenAI alerts over 100 organizations about rogue AI agent activity
items.summary: Expanding its review of the July Hugging Face breach, OpenAI said it has now notified more than 100 organizations about unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents, as it continues sifting roughly 50 petabytes of data to scope the incident.

items.headline: ChatGPT adds virtual clothing try-on and shopping Favorites
items.summary: OpenAI launched a 'Try on' feature that renders clothing and accessories onto a user's photo, plus a Favorites list for saving products, both powered by a new ChatGPT Images 2.5 model aimed at making ChatGPT a bigger shopping destination.

items.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon to trusted cyber defenders ahead of wider release
items.summary: Google DeepMind's new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, is being given to select cybersecurity partners without standard cyber guardrails so it can autonomously find, test and patch vulnerabilities, before a broader rollout to enterprises and developers.

items.headline: Shopify debuts Canvas, an AI chat-based store builder
items.summary: Shopify's new Canvas tool lets merchants build fully custom, functional online stores by chatting with its Sidekick AI agent, rendering real working code in real time rather than a static mockup and cutting typical build time to about 20 minutes.

items.headline: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
items.summary: DoorDash rolled out an AI ordering agent reachable through Apple Messages that can interpret requests like 'order my usual,' recommend a cart from local merchants, and handle group orders with mixed dietary needs, as it competes with Uber Eats and Grubhub on agentic ordering.

items.headline: ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22 billion in secondary share sale
items.summary: AI voice startup ElevenLabs completed a $300 million employee tender led by Wellington Management and T. Rowe Price, doubling its valuation from February's Series D as the company eyes a public listing within two to three years.

items.headline: Satlyt raises $8M to run AI workloads on satellites
items.summary: Founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, Satlyt raised an $8 million seed round to build open software that distributes computing tasks across satellites in orbit, aiming to become an 'Android' alternative to SpaceX's closed approach.

items.headline: Hearing startup Legato launches AI-powered hearing glasses
items.summary: Legato began selling its $999 Legato Frames, eyewear with embedded AI hearing-assistance technology that isolates voices from background noise for people with mild to moderate hearing loss, following its emergence from stealth with $12 million in funding.

items.headline: Figure 03 humanoid climbs 15 feet up and down a ladder fully autonomously
items.summary: Figure AI showed its Figure 03 humanoid robot ascending and descending a ladder-like structure without human control, using its Helix vision-language-action model, in a fresh demonstration of whole-body balance and coordination considered one of the harder mobility tests for humanoid robots.

items.headline: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 pushes ChatGPT and Codex deeper into agentic work
items.summary: At DevDay, OpenAI expanded its model lineup and developer tools with a focus on long-running agents and new human-AI collaboration workflows, including the lower-cost GPT-6.1 Sol model aimed at everyday coding and computer-use tasks.
